opposite.en: A fusion reaction has the opposite problem: it is incredibly difficult to keep going.
opposite.zh: 核聚变反应则面临相反的问题：它极难维持。

opposite.en: If you describe food as mushy, you mean it's soft – the opposite of crunchy.
opposite.zh: 如果你把食物描述为软绵绵的，你是说它很软——与酥脆相反。

opposite.en: There is also something called a dysphemism, which functions as the opposite of a euphemism.
opposite.zh: 还有一种东西叫做反委婉语（dysphemism），它的功能与委婉语相反。

opposite.en: These settlements developed in the early 13th century on opposite sides of the River Spree.
opposite.zh: 这些定居点在13世纪初发展于施普雷河的两岸。

opposite.en: It’s the opposite to a fixed mindset. Fixed mindset… your ability is fixed.
opposite.zh: 这与固定型思维恰恰相反。固定型思维……你的能力是固定的。

opinion.en: Subjective things are based on your own personal opinions and feelings rather than objective facts.
opinion.zh: subjective(主观的)的事物，是基于你个人的看法和感受，而非客观事实。

opinion.en: So, Phil, what's the worst thing someone can do while eating, in your opinion?
opinion.zh: 那么 Phil，在你看来，一个人在吃饭时能做的最糟糕的事情是什么？

opinion.en: And how can we be more accepting and open to the opinions of others?
opinion.zh: 我们该如何变得更加包容，并以开放的心态对待他人的意见呢？

opinion.en: The phrase on the other hand is used to introduce a contrasting opinion or statement.
opinion.zh: 短语“on the other hand”用于引出相反的观点或陈述。

opinion.en: So Neil, have you changed your opinion after hearing both sides of the story?
opinion.zh: 那么尼尔，听了双方的说法后，你改变看法了吗？

operate.en: Eventually, the Constitution was ratified, was approved, and in 1789, the new government began operating.
operate.zh: 最终，宪法得到了批准，并在1789年，新政府开始运作。

operate.en: It had to make itself an attractive place for international companies to operate.
operate.zh: 它必须把自己变成一个对国际公司运营极具吸引力的地方。

operate.en: The original Mr Punch, Pulcinella, was a marionette: a puppet on strings, operated from above.
operate.zh: 最初的 Mr Punch，即 Pulcinella，是一个提线木偶（marionette）：一种用绳子从上方操纵的木偶。

operate.en: These included the ability to collect taxes, build fortifications, and operate independently of local authorities.
operate.zh: 其中包括征税、建造防御工事以及独立于地方当局运作的能力。

operate.en: Siemens is a huge German multinational company that operates around the world.
operate.zh: 西门子是一家在全球运营的庞大德国跨国公司。

option.en: But the other option is to leave them in space, for use in space.
option.zh: 但另一个选择是把它们留在太空中，在太空里使用。

option.en: On paper, they are not absolutely poor, but in reality, their options are extremely limited.
option.zh: 在纸面上，他们并不绝对贫困，但在现实中，他们的选择极其有限。

option.en: You can hear English every day. But there are other options and countries out there.
option.zh: 你每天都能听到英语。但外面还有其他的选择和国家。

option.en: One option is to bring them back to Earth and use them here.
option.zh: 一种选择是将它们带回地球并在本地使用。

option.en: Like the rat, if he has no option to escape, he will attack.
option.zh: 就像老鼠一样，如果他没有逃跑的选择，他就会发起攻击。

optical.en: Black and white stripes created an optical illusion, a visual trick that makes your eyes see things differently from how they really are.
optical.zh: 黑白条纹创造了一种 optical illusion（视觉错觉），这是一种让你的眼睛看到与实际情况不同事物的视觉把戏。

optical.en: Woohoo! OK. Let's recap the vocabulary we've learned, starting with optical illusion – a visual trick where your eyes perceive things differently from how they really are.
optical.zh: 呜呼！好了。让我们温习一下我们学过的词汇，首先是 optical illusion（视觉错觉）——一种让你的眼睛感知到与实际情况不同事物的视觉把戏。

oppose.en: The phrase us versus them is used to show hostility between two opposing groups.
oppose.zh: us versus them 这个短语用来表示两个对立群体之间的敌意。

oppose.en: He cracked down on dissent, exiling or imprisoning those who opposed his vision.
oppose.zh: 他严厉打击异见，将那些反对他愿景的人流放或关入监狱。

oppose.en: Many Polish people strongly opposed Russian rule, and different uprisings broke out against Russian authorities.
oppose.zh: 许多波兰人强烈反对俄国统治，针对俄国当局爆发了多次起义。

oppose.en: There were two opposing ideologies facing each other across a line of concrete and barbed wire.
oppose.zh: 在一条由混凝土和带刺铁丝网构成的分界线上，有两个相互对立的意识形态在对峙。

oppose.en: As you might imagine, many opposed Atatürk’s decision.
oppose.zh: 正如你所想象的那样，许多人反对阿塔图尔克的决定。

optimistic.en: Many younger Americans, many younger people in the US, are less optimistic about the future.
optimistic.zh: 许多年轻的美国人、美国许多年轻人对未来不那么乐观。

optimistic.en: The adjective uplifted means feeling cheerful, happy and optimistic.
optimistic.zh: 形容词“振奋的”意味着感到高兴、快乐和乐观。

optimistic.en: Many US citizens feel a little bit pessimistic about their future, but a lot of immigrants to the US remain optimistic about their opportunities.
optimistic.zh: 许多美国公民对他们的未来感到有些悲观，但许多美国移民对他们的机遇依然保持乐观。

optimistic.en: The optimistic view is that they can't. At some point, prices must correct, either through a crash or through a long period of stagnation while wages gradually catch up.
optimistic.zh: 乐观的看法是它们不能。在某个时刻，房价必须进行修正，要么通过市场崩盘，要么通过长期的停滞期，直到工资逐渐赶上来。

optimistic.en: If you believe you aren’t naturally good at languages and you can’t improve, you’re going to spend less time practicing, and you’re going to be less optimistic about your future.
optimistic.zh: 如果你认为自己天生不擅长语言且无法进步，你花在练习上的时间就会减少，而且你对未来的看法也会不那么乐观。

opportunity.en: At the same time, there are significant opportunities for the EU to strengthen itself.
opportunity.zh: 与此同时，欧盟也迎来了巩固自身的重要机遇。

opportunity.en: Studying in those countries gives you opportunities to encounter English outside of your classroom.
opportunity.zh: 在这些国家学习为你提供了在教室之外接触英语的机会。

opportunity.en: That created an opportunity for France, who were one of Portugal’s biggest European rivals.
opportunity.zh: 这为法国创造了机会，法国是葡萄牙在欧洲最大的竞争对手之一。

opportunity.en: They believe America still offers more opportunity than almost anywhere else in the world.
opportunity.zh: 他们坚信，与世界上几乎其他任何地方相比，美国依然提供了更多的机遇。

opportunity.en: It quickly became a bestseller, and had brought the already successful Chua countless opportunities.
opportunity.zh: 这本书迅速成为畅销书，并为本已功成名就的蔡美儿带来了无数机遇。

operation.en: By the time he landed, he expected Operation Valkyrie to be well underway.
operation.zh: 当他降落时，他本以为“瓦尔基里行动”已经在紧锣密鼓地进行了。

operation.en: But unbeknownst to Hitler, Operation Valkyrie was being used to take him down.
operation.zh: 但希特勒不知道的是，“瓦尔基里行动”正被用来推翻他。

operation.en: Operations were painful and brutal, and Darwin soon realized that the medical profession wasn’t for him.
operation.zh: 手术过程痛苦且残忍，Darwin很快意识到医学行业并不适合他。

operation.en: By the late 1800s, the Christmas Island Phosphate Company had begun large scale mining operations.
operation.zh: 到 19 世纪末，圣诞岛磷酸盐公司已经开始了大规模的采矿作业。

operation.en: The operation is called Azalée. There is no fighting.
operation.zh: 该行动代号为“杜鹃花”（Azalée）。过程没有发生交火。

opening.en: But while this anonymity made prosecutions difficult, it also gave federal agents an opening.
opening.zh: 虽然这种匿名性让起诉变得困难，但也给联邦探员提供了一个突破口。

opening.en: Hardy later said that reading Ramanujan’s work was like “opening a treasure chest full of mathematical jewels.”
opening.zh: Hardy后来评价说，阅读Ramanujan的作品就像是“打开了一个装满数学珍宝的宝箱。”

opening.en: It is in the final stages of opening a nuclear storage site deep underground that will be able to safely store nuclear waste for 100,000 years.
opening.zh: 它正处于在地下深处启用一个核存储库的最后阶段，该存储库将能够安全地储存核废料长达10万年。

opening.en: The monarch, the King’s, responsibilities include opening Parliament, appointing governors, and giving assent to new laws, giving their permission for new laws to be made.
opening.zh: 君主即国王的职责包括：主持议会开幕、任命总督，以及批准新法律、给予新法案颁布实施的许可。

opera.en: It had newspapers. An opera house. A telegraph office.
opera.zh: 镇上有报纸，有歌剧院，还有电报局。

opera.en: When I mention Australia, I guess most of you listening think about the Sydney Opera House, scuba diving around the Great Barrier Reef, or maybe sports like Australian Rules Football.
opera.zh: 每当提到澳大利亚，我猜你们大多数听众脑海中浮现的都是悉尼歌剧院、大堡礁周围的潜水，或者像澳式橄榄球这样的运动。

opaque.en: Billions of dollars had been siphoned off through decades of patronage, contracts, and opaque deals, and the government–or rather, MBS–said it was time to clean up the system.
opaque.zh: 数十年的裙带关系、合同和不透明交易吞噬了数十亿美元，政府——或者说MBS——表示是时候整顿这个体制了。

opponent.en: In 2014, Sisi ran for president, winning in a landslide against a token opponent.
opponent.zh: 2014 年，Sisi 竞选总统，在与一个象征性对手的对决中压倒性胜出。

opponent.en: Instead, the condottieri would rely on sieges, ambushes, and psychological tactics to wear down their opponents.
opponent.zh: 相反，condottieri 会依靠围城、伏击和心理战术来消耗对手。

opponent.en: This often meant that the President and Vice President could be political opponents with very different ideas.
opponent.zh: 这意味着总统和副总统往往是政治观点截然不同的政敌。

opponent.en: And finally, to his opponents, foreign and domestic, it warns them not to back him into a corner.
opponent.zh: 最后，对于国内外的对手，这警告他们不要把他逼入绝境。

opponent.en: Political opponents were arrested, imprisoned, or forced into exile.
opponent.zh: 政治反对派被捕、入狱或被迫流亡。

optional.en: Discretionary spending is the only category that is “optional”, which can be increased or decreased by Congress.
optional.zh: 可自由支配支出是唯一的“可选”类别，可以由国会增加或减少。

optimism.en: So in short, a bubble is a mix of hope, excitement, and too much optimism.
optimism.zh: 简而言之，泡沫是希望、狂热和过度乐观的混合体。

optimism.en: There is a lot of optimism, but also a lot of hype.
optimism.zh: 这里面有很高的乐观情绪，但也充满了过度的炒作。

optimism.en: All this optimism had, within 12 months really, given way to disappointment.
optimism.zh: 所有这些乐观情绪在短短 12 个月内确实让位给了失望。

optimism.en: The interwar period, which means the years between World War I and World War II, was a time of optimism in.
optimism.zh: 两次世界大战之间的时期，也就是一战和二战之间的年份，是充满乐观情绪的时期。

opium.en: He then started to sell opium and opened brothels and gambling dens on Christmas Island.
opium.zh: 然后他开始在圣诞岛上出售鸦片，并开设妓院和赌场。

opium.en: This meant that when the men were paid for their mining work, they would basically be giving back their money to Ong Sam Leong’s companies, either by buying opium from him or using his brothels and gambling dents.
opium.zh: 这意味着当这些男人因为采矿工作拿到工资时，他们基本上会把钱还给黄三龙的公司，要么是通过向他购买鸦片，要么是使用他的妓院和赌场。
